what: The enrollment seal, as both the gateway and the OramaOS agent must compute it.
why: The gateway (core) and the agent (os/agent) are separate Go modules and cannot import each other, so each has its own copy of the seal. This vector is the only thing stopping them drifting: change one and that side's test fails against this file.

algorithm.kdf: HKDF-SHA256, no salt, info = purpose, 32-byte output
